title: The Iron Miniature
template:
The tiny engine hissed as it began its journey across the [adjective_1] landscape. It chugged past a miniature forest made of soft sponges. The little conductor waved a plastic flag at the onlookers.

Soon, the train approached a [noun_1] that spanned the blue paper river. The sound of the wheels on the tracks echoed through the quiet room. Suddenly, a [adjective_2] cat peeked over the mountain range. The passengers, carved from wood, didn't seem to mind the giant feline.

The train finally arrived at the station near the [noun_2] garden. It came to a slow, [adverb_1] stop right at the edge of the table. The hobbyist smiled, ready to reset the track for another trip.
